name: Linkedin Article
description: Writes LinkedIn-formatted thought leadership articles with professional credibility markers, structured arguments, and platform-specific formatting. Use when the user wants to publish a long-form article on LinkedIn, write thought leadership content for a professional audience, or create LinkedIn Pulse content. Do NOT use for short LinkedIn posts (use `linkedin-post`), general blog posts (use `blog-post-writing`), or Twitter threads (use `twitter-thread`).
